## Options
*[How to use device type specific configuration](../guide/configuration/devices-groups.md#specific-device-options)*

* `invert_cover`: Inverts the reported cover position and the state derived from it, false: open=100,close=0, true: open=0,close=100 (default false). The value must be `true` or `false`

* `cover_position_tilt_disable_report`: Do not publish set cover target position as a normal 'position' value (default false). The value must be `true` or `false`


## Exposes

### Cover 
The current state of this cover is in the published state under the `state` property (value is `OPEN` or `CLOSE`).
To control this cover publish a message to topic `zigbee2mqtt/FRIENDLY_NAME/set` with payload `{"state": "OPEN"}`, `{"state": "CLOSE"}`, `{"state": "STOP"}`.
It's not possible to read (`/get`) this value.
To change the position publish a message to topic `zigbee2mqtt/FRIENDLY_NAME/set` with payload `{"position": VALUE}` where `VALUE` is a number between `0` and `100`.

### Battery (numeric)
Remaining battery in %, can take up to 24 hours before reported.
Value can be found in the published state on the `battery` property.
It's not possible to read (`/get`) or write (`/set`) this value.
The minimal value is `0` and the maximum value is `100`.
The unit of this value is `%`.

### Calibration (enum)
Enter mode (F002=0) and wait for automatic movement to stop; start up (1), STOP to save, start down (2), STOP to save. The motor reports completion (3)..
Value will **not** be published in the state.
It's not possible to read (`/get`) this value.
To write (`/set`) a value publish a message to topic `zigbee2mqtt/FRIENDLY_NAME/set` with payload `{"calibration": "VALUE"}`.
The possible values are: `enter_mode`, `up_start`, `save_limit`, `down_start`.

### Calibration completed (binary)
Whether the device has reported calibration completion since the last calibration action.
Value can be found in the published state on the `calibration_completed` property.
It's not possible to read (`/get`) or write (`/set`) this value.
If value equals `true` calibration completed is ON, if `false` OFF.

### Work state (enum)
Value can be found in the published state on the `work_state` property.
It's not possible to read (`/get`) or write (`/set`) this value.
The possible values are: `standby`, `opening`, `closing`.

### Total travel time (numeric)
Total travel time reported by the device after calibration.
Value can be found in the published state on the `time_total` property.
It's not possible to read (`/get`) or write (`/set`) this value.
The minimal value is `0` and the maximum value is `120`.
The unit of this value is `s`.

### Charge state (enum)
Value can be found in the published state on the `charge_state` property.
It's not possible to read (`/get`) or write (`/set`) this value.
The possible values are: `uncharged`, `charging`, `charged`.

### Curtain close direction (binary)
Value can be found in the published state on the `curtain_close_direction` property.
It's not possible to read (`/get`) this value.
To write (`/set`) a value publish a message to topic `zigbee2mqtt/FRIENDLY_NAME/set` with payload `{"curtain_close_direction": "VALUE"}`.
If value equals `DOWN` curtain close direction is ON, if `UP` OFF.

### Charge led switch (binary)
Value can be found in the published state on the `charge_led_switch` property.
It's not possible to read (`/get`) this value.
To write (`/set`) a value publish a message to topic `zigbee2mqtt/FRIENDLY_NAME/set` with payload `{"charge_led_switch": "VALUE"}`.
If value equals `ON` charge led switch is ON, if `OFF` OFF.
